title: Hawaii state building codes; prohibitions.
bodyText:
In adopting the Hawaii state building codes, the council shall not adopt provisions that:

(1) Relate to administrative, permitting, or enforcement and inspection procedures of each county; or

(2) Conflict with:

(A) Chapters 444 and 464; or

(B) Section 46-4.7.
bodyHtml:
§107-26  Hawaii state building codes; prohibitions.  In adopting the Hawaii state building codes, the council shall not adopt provisions that:

     (1)  Relate to administrative, permitting, or enforcement and inspection procedures of each county; or

     (2)  Conflict with:

          (A)  Chapters 444 and 464; or

          (B)  Section 46-4.7. [L 2007, c 82, pt of §2; am L 2014, c 164, §7; am L 2024, c 37, §3]
